CheckTitle: Security Groups with MongoDB ports (27017, 27018) open to the internet
Description: Security Groups have been found to allow access from the internet to MongoDB ports.
Risk: Public MongoDB ports (e.g., 27017) have a history of mass ransomware and data theft incidents where unauthenticated databases are wiped or held for ransom.

Recommendation.Text: Make sure security groups do not allow any access from the internet to ports, unless required as per business requirements.
